title: Harmonious Colorings: bounds, heuristics and integer-linear formulations
summary: A proper coloring $c$ of a simple graph $G$ is harmonious if, for every pair of distinct edges $uv,xy\in E(G)$, we have that $\{c(u),c(v)\}\neq \{c(x),c(y)\}$. The harmonious chromatic number of $G$, denoted by $h(G)$, is the least positive integer $k$ such that $G$ has a harmonious coloring with $k$ colors. In this work, we extend an idea presented in [Kolay, et al. Harmonious coloring: Parameterized algorithms and upper bounds. Theor. Comp.
